Fortescue Zero launches racing and innovation team to compete in ABB FIA Formula E World Championship.
evidence.body: [e002:f01] Fortescue Zero is going from the pit lane to the grid, launching its Fortescue Zero racing and innovation team to compete in the world’s biggest electric racing series. [e002:f02] The new customer team intends to be the first Australian owned outfit to race in the ABB FIA Formula E World Championship, with plans to join for the start of the 2026/27 season, subject to FEO and FIA approvals. [e002:f03] Fortescue Zero has a long and successful legacy in motorsports, from its roots in Williams Racing, to becoming an in-demand, high-performance engineering business, working at the cutting edge of electrification. [e002:f04] Unique and innovative technologies created by Fortescue Zero’s highly skilled engineers have helped redefine electric performance on the racetrack and are now being applied across commercial electric vehicles and heavy industry. [e002:f05] Fortescue Growth and Energy CEO, Gus Pichot said, “For more than a decade Fortescue Zero has been the brains behind some of the groundbreaking technologies powering and transforming electric racing. [e002:f06] Now, we’re going to show the world how we can compete on the track as well.” “Progressing from the pit lane to the grid is the next chapter in our motorsports story. [e002:f07] We’re here to race, to win and to innovate.” “At Fortescue, it’s in our DNA to go to the extreme, push the limits and go further and faster than our competitors. [e002:f08] Fortescue Zero Electromobility Chief Technology Officer Travis Hester said “Formula E is pushing electric racing to another level, creating completely new engineering challenges. [e002:f09] That is exactly where we want to be, at the front of the grid, solving difficult problems and finding the next competitive advantage.” “Motor racing allows Fortescue Zero engineers to design & develop technologies at the cutting edge of performance and efficiency. [e002:f10] Battery, software and hardware technology is proven in the harsh environment of racing, then efficiency applications applied throughout Fortescue’s mining and energy portfolio, as well as Fortescue Zero’s automotive and defence customers.” Penske Autosport owner Jay Penske said, “We are proud of what we have built with this team and the people who have competed at the highest levels of elite racing.” “Fortescue Zero has a clear ambition for electric technology and motorsport and we know it will build upon the great foundations we have laid and lead to future success.” Fortescue Zero has been a part of Formula E since the early years of the Championship, developing and supplying a range of technologies. [e002:f11] As well as a technical partnership with Jaguar TCS Racing, Fortescue Zero was also the official PIT BOOST provider for the 2024/25 and 2025/26 seasons of the Championship. [e002:f12] Formula E CEO Jeff Dodds said, “Fortescue Zero has been a vital technology partner for Formula E from day one, standing alongside us since the inception of the Championship.” “Formula E is far more than a race series, it’s an incubator for peak performance and ground-breaking technology, and Fortescue Zero exemplifies both.” “We are excited to see the competitive edge and innovation they will bring to the GEN4 era of the ABB FIA Formula E World Championship.” Technology and innovation are central to Fortescue's strategy to accelerate the decarbonisation of heavy industry and create new sources of long-term value. [e002:f13] Fortescue Zero’s motorsports engineering heritage is central to that strategy, delivering high-performance innovations tested and proven on the track and scaled for trucks and mine sites in the Pilbara. [e002:f14] The power systems, fast chargers and world-leading battery intelligence being implemented on our mine sites, started on the racetrack and are now real-world applications, reducing emissions. [e002:f15] Fortescue Energy and Growth CEO Gus Pichot said, “In racing every second counts, and innovations can be the difference between winning and losing. [e002:f16] The same goes for decarbonising our mining operations.” “We need technology that can operate at extremes and push the limits.

evidence.title: HondaJet Echelon delayed to 2031 as Honda pushes first flight to 2028
evidence.body: [e003:f01] The revised schedule represents a substantial delay for the company's second aircraft program. [e003:f02] Honda originally targeted a first flight in 2026, followed by type certification and initial deliveries in 2028. [e003:f03] Honda disclosed the new timeline as it announced the completion of the first wing assembly for the Echelon at its headquarters in Greensboro, North Carolina. [e003:f04] HndaJet Echelon | Honda Range of 2,625 nautical miles Honda formally launched the aircraft, initially known as the HondaJet 2600 Concept, in 2023. [e003:f05] Honda says the Echelon is being designed to offer fuel efficiency around 20% better than other light jets and more than 40% better than midsize aircraft on a typical mission. [e003:f06] Honda said it has accumulated more than 530 letters of intent for the Echelon since announcing plans to commercialize the aircraft. [e003:f07] The Echelon is intended to expand Honda Aircraft beyond the very light jet segment occupied by the HA-420 and compete with larger business aircraft while retaining operating economics closer to smaller jets. [e003:f08] Its planned range would also make it the first Honda Aircraft product capable of flying nonstop between many city pairs across the continental United States. [e003:f09] HondaJet Echelon | Honda Long development history at Honda Aircraft The revised Echelon timeline adds another lengthy development cycle to Honda's relatively short history as an aircraft manufacturer. [e003:f10] Honda began research that eventually led to the original HondaJet in 1997. [e003:f11] The experimental aircraft made its first flight in December 2003, and Honda announced its decision to commercialize the design in 2006. [e003:f12] In 2009, Honda moved the planned first delivery from 2010 to late 2011, citing delays involving suppliers. [e003:f13] The HA-420 eventually received FAA type certification in December 2015, almost 12 years after the first prototype flight and around nine years after Honda decided to commercialize the aircraft. [e003:f14] Honda Aircraft has since developed several improved versions of the HA-420, culminating in the current HondaJet Elite II. [e003:f15] HondaJet 12 HondaJets delivered in 2025 Honda Aircraft also remains a relatively small manufacturer in a business jet market that has expanded in recent years. [e003:f16] Honda Aircraft delivered 12 HondaJets during 2025 , including no aircraft during the second quarter.

evidence.title: Fabbri come Sinner, Egonu e Antonelli, è il n° 1 del peso e ha cancellato la beffa dell'Ultimate Championship
evidence.body: [e004:f01] 16/09/26 17:14 3 min di lettura Rino Dazzo Giornalista Se mai ci fosse modo di traslare il glossario del calcio in una nicchia di esperti, lui ne farebbe parte. [e004:f02] Non si perde una svista arbitrale né gli umori social del mondo delle curve C’è un atleta italiano che ha chiuso la stagione al numero 1 della classifica mondiale, anticipando (tocchiamo ferro) Jannik Sinner, Kimi Antonelli e le ragazze della Nazionale di pallavolo femminile, da Paola Egonu a tutte le altre. [e004:f03] Si tratta di Leonardo Fabbri, a cui World Athletics ha consegnato idealmente lo scettro di “re del 2026”. [e004:f04] Un’annata da sogno per il 29enne toscano, tifosissimo della Fiorentina ma soprattutto protagonista assoluto nella sua specialità: il getto del peso. [e004:f05] Un primato certificato dai successi ottenuti in questa stagione, ma che proprio in extremis era stato messo a rischio. [e004:f06] Fabbri batte Campbell nel ranking mondiale di World Athletics La beffa dell'Ultimate Championship: niente peso in calendario Il 2026 d'oro di Fabbri: Birmingham, Roma, Eugene e la numero 1 Fabbri batte Campbell nel ranking mondiale di World Athletics Fabbri, come comunicato dalla federazione internazionale, ha chiuso il ranking annuale a quota 1.400 punti , appena tre in più del giamaicano Rajindra Campbell che, con una poderoso scatto nelle ultime settimane, si era avvicinato pericolosamente, arrivando a sole tre lunghezze dall’azzurro: 1.397 il suo bottino finale. [e004:f07] Campbell che si era aggiudicato il duello finale in Diamond League , portando a casa il diamante grazie a un lancio della misura di 23,08 metri, di poco superiore al 22,74 stabilito da Fabbri qualche tempo prima , che a lungo era stata la miglior performance mondiale dell’anno. [e004:f08] La beffa dell’Ultimate Championship: niente peso in calendario Il duello non si è ripetuto all’Ultimate Championship, dove Fabbri e lo stesso Campbell sono stati vittime di una vera e propria beffa: il getto del peso maschile, infatti, non è stato incluso nel novero delle specialità presenti nel programma del “Mondiale dei Mondiali” di Budapest, circostanza che ha privato il campione azzurro della possibilità di andare a giocarsi i 150mila dollari di montepremi riservati al vincitore. [e004:f09] Leo s’è consolato col riconoscimento di aver chiuso l’anno da numero 1. [e004:f10] Sarà lui l’uomo da battere anche nella prossima stagione, anche se la concorrenza si annuncia più agguerrita che mai. [e004:f11] Il 2026 d’oro di Fabbri: Birmingham, Roma, Eugene e la numero 1 I 1.400 punti che lo hanno consacrato in cima al ranking sono il frutto degli eccellenti risultati ottenuti in stagione dall’allievo del tecnico Paolo Dal Soglio , confermatosi campione d’Europa a Birmingham e laureatosi vincitore in due meeting di eccezionale prestigio per la Diamond League: il Golden Gala a Roma e il Prefontaine Classic di Eugene . [e004:f12] Tutta la stagione di Fabbri è tata accompagnata da risultati di notevole prestigio e spessore, a conferma della crescita e maturazione di un talento indiscusso dell’atletica italiana. [e004:f13] Uno dei pochi azzurri capace di chiudere l’anno in cima al mondo . [e004:f14] Si contano sulle dita di una mano.

evidence.title: TRIDENT confirm the signing of Kean Nakamura-Berta for the 2027 season
evidence.body: [e005:f01] Having made the step up from karting in 2023, Nakamura-Berta boasts an impressive record in single seaters having won 2025 Italian F4 and E4 Championships titles. [e005:f02] In 2026, the Williams Driver Academy member won Formula Regional Middle East Trophy title, and he also finished third in the Formula Regional European Championship. [e005:f03] Nakamura-Berta is now set to graduate to Formula 3 in 2027, and at the announcement, he expressed his delight at the opportunity to race with TRIDENT. [e005:f04] “I’m pleased to be stepping up to F3 with TRIDENT Motorsport while still having the ongoing support of the Williams F1 Team Driver Academy,” said Nakamura-Berta. [e005:f05] “Finishing the season strongly in FREC and having the opportunity to join such a competitive team in F3 gives me great confidence as I look ahead to my F3 debut next year. [e005:f06] A big thank you to everyone involved who helped get me here.” TRIDENT Team Manager Giacomo Ricci added: “We are extremely pleased to announce the arrival of Kean Nakamura-Berta at TRIDENT Motorsport for the 2027 FIA Formula 3 Championship season. [e005:f07] Kean is a driver we have known and followed for some time, and he has demonstrated he has all the qualities needed to take this important step. [e005:f08] His journey, from karting to Formula Regional, has been marked by constant growth and impressive results. [e005:f09] It will be a pleasure to begin this collaboration and work together to best prepare for such an important campaign. [e005:f10] We are convinced that Trident represents the ideal environment to allow Kean to continue his growth and express his full potential in the FIA Formula 3 series.” Williams F1 Team Sporting Director Sven Smeets also added: “It's a proud moment to see Kean step up to F3 with Trident Motorsport for his rookie season. [e005:f11] He has made impressive progress since joining the Academy this year, and this opportunity is a culmination of the hard work and dedication he's shown across a long and hard-fought title campaign, backed by an already outstanding record. [e005:f12] This is a great moment for the Driver Academy, and a fitting reflection of the opportunities it creates for the next generation of talented drivers.” Next Up Related Articles IMAGE GALLERY: Some of the best pictures from the final round in Madrid PREVIEW: Round 9 in Madrid brings it all to a close Escotto and Xie withdrawn from Madrid round Taponen reflects on ‘satisfying’ end to the season after victory in Madrid TITLE-WINNING ANALYSIS: The moment that earned Ugochukwu the 2026 title SPRINT RACE: Nael in full control for third win of 2026。

evidence.title: Alpine hires ex-Mercedes F1 tech chief
evidence.body: [e001:f01] Alpine said Elliott, who had a previous stint at the team as principal aerodynamicist in its Renault/Lotus iterations from 2008 to 2012, will "lead and oversee the technical and engineering functions at the team's factory at Enstone". [e001:f02] Elliott joined Mercedes when he previously left Enstone and was a key part of Mercedes' technical team through its domination of the late 2010s. [e001:f03] But his time in charge of it coincided with Mercedes' slump in the 2022 rules era. [e001:f04] He succeeded James Allison as technical director going into those regulations, but the 'no sidepod' design concept created under Elliott's leadership was problematic and Mercedes fell from fighting for titles to just occasional race wins. [e001:f05] Elliott and Allison swapped roles back in early 2023 after Mercedes failed to make the hoped-for gains that winter, with Elliott moving into the chief technical officer role Allison had held and Allison becoming technical director again. [e001:f06] Six months later, Elliott announced that he was leaving Mercedes and taking a break from F1 altogether - a break that's now ended with his Alpine appointment. [e001:f07] Alpine said signing Elliott "strengthens the team's technical capabilities as the team looks to build on the improved performances on track and close the gap to the top four teams", and his chief technical officer title suggests a likely focus on bigger-picture development and future regulations work, while existing executive technical director David Sanchez leads development of the 2026 and '27 cars. [e001:f08] Advertisement 00:00。

evidence.title: Hamilton investe nello spettacolo: accordo con Skydance legata a Gerry Cardinale
evidence.body: [e002:f01] La Dawn Apollo Studios, casa di produzione del ferrarista, ha siglato un'intesa per lo sviluppo e la produzione di contenuti con la società partecipata da RedBird, fondata e guidata dal presidente del Milan. [e002:f02] Il pilota avrà il ruolo di produttore esecutivo per ciascun progetto C’è anche un filo che porta al Milan nella nuova avventura di Lewis Hamilton nel mondo dello spettacolo. [e002:f03] Il pilota della Ferrari ha siglato una nuova intesa per espandere le proprie attività nell'intrattenimento: come riportato da Hollywood Reporter, la sua casa di produzione, Dawn Apollo Studios, ha infatti stretto un accordo pluriennale con Skydance Sports, la divisione dedicata all'intrattenimento sportivo all'interno del gruppo Paramount Skydance. [e002:f04] Skydance, gruppo di cui fa parte Skydance Sports, è legata a Gerry Cardinale perché RedBird Capital Partners, la società d’investimento fondata e guidata da Cardinale, è investitore di Skydance dal 2019. [e002:f05] La partnership prevede lo sviluppo e la produzione di contenuti scripted, unscripted e d'animazione, con il pilota nel ruolo di produttore esecutivo per ciascun progetto. [e002:f06] L'intesa offre inoltre la possibilità di estendere la collaborazione ad altre aree del gruppo Paramount, compresi i videogiochi e i prodotti di consumo. [e002:f07] Fondata nel 2022 dallo stesso Hamilton, Dawn Apollo Studios ha debuttato con il film di successo F1 targato Apple e interpretato da Brad Pitt, progetto nel quale il pilota ha figurato come produttore e ha realizzato un cameo nei panni di se stesso. [e002:f08] Per rafforzare la struttura aziendale, Hamilton — rappresentato dall'agente Josh Pyatt presso Win Artists — ha recentemente ingaggiato la veterana di Fulwell Entertainment Naomi Wright nel ruolo di Senior VP dello sviluppo. [e002:f09] Nel commentare la partnership, Hamilton ha sottolineato il valore della narrazione: "Ho sempre creduto che le storie possano aiutare le persone a vedere il mondo diversamente e a innescare conversazioni importanti". [e002:f10] Il pilota ha spiegato che l'obiettivo di Dawn Apollo Studios è sostenere progetti autentici, audaci e significativi, offrendo spazio a voci e prospettive tradizionalmente meno rappresentate, dichiarandosi felice di fare squadra con il team di Skydance Sports. [e002:f11] Skydance Sports, guidata da Jesse Sisgold (Presidente di Paramount Sports Entertainment e Chair di Skydance Sports), si occupa dello sviluppo di produzioni legate al mondo dello sport e ha siglato in passato intese analoghe, tra cui un contratto "first-look" con il quarterback dei Buffalo Bills e MVP dell'NFL Josh Allen, la cui serie NFL Play Action è di recente approdata su Paramount+. evidence.body: [e002:f01] Starship Flight 14 is more than another test launch for SpaceX. [e002:f02] For more than three years, SpaceX has been testing Starship one step at a time. [e002:f03] Now, the company is preparing for a milestone it has not achieved before: sending the giant spacecraft into orbit and bringing it back down after a much longer flight. [e002:f04] The 14th Starship test flight, currently targeted for September 28, 2026, is expected to last around 10 hours and could see the spacecraft complete six orbits around Earth. [e002:f05] Starship is also being developed as the spacecraft that NASA plans to use as a Human Landing System (HLS) for future Artemis lunar missions. [e002:f06] Unlike conventional rockets that are largely discarded after launch, SpaceX is developing Starship so that both stages can eventually be recovered and flown again. [e002:f07] The idea is simple: if the same rocket can be reused repeatedly, SpaceX could potentially launch more frequently and reduce the cost of putting large amounts of cargo into space. [e002:f09] SpaceX's Flight 14 mission plan calls for the upper stage to reach about 275 km and complete six trips around Earth before a planned splashdown in the Pacific. [e002:f13] Flight 14 is also significant for SpaceX's satellite internet business. [e002:f14] SpaceX says this will be the first time it plans to deploy V3 satellites into the operational constellation. evidence.title: “STARSHIPと契約終了”宇宙少女 ソラ＆ウンソ、ファンに心境告白「素敵な姿で戻って来る」
evidence.body: [e006:f01] ソラは本日（17日）、自身のInstagramに直筆手紙を投稿し、「15年間共に歩んできたSTARSHIPエンターテインメントを離れ、新たなスタートを切ることになった」と明らかにした。 [e006:f02] そして「15年という長い時間の中で本当に多くの学びがあり、嬉しかった日や胸がいっぱいになった日も、思い通りにいかず悲しかった日もあったが、その全ての時間を経て多くのことを学び、成長することができた。 [e006:f03] そして、その全ての時間が今の私を作ったのだと思う」と振り返り、STARSHIPエンターテインメントとファンに感謝の気持ちを伝えた。 [e006:f04] 彼女は「新しい道を歩み始めるということは、私にとっても慣れないことで緊張するが、自分のペースに合わせて一歩一歩、真心を込めて進んでいきたい。 [e006:f05] これから続いていく私の新たなスタートも、温かい目で見守っていただきたい。 [e006:f06] さらに素敵な姿でご挨拶する」と決意を語った。 [e006:f07] またウンソも、自身のInstagramを通じて、メッセージを公開。 [e006:f08] 「2012年、STARSHIPエンターテインメントの練習生として初めて会社の扉を開き、練習室に入った日からデビューを夢見て、時には疲れ果てても再び立ち上がり、今の私になるまで、宇宙少女のウンソとしての活動と、女優ソン・ジュヨンとしての14年間があった」と振り返った。 [e006:f09] 続いて「私の青春の多くの思い出がSTARSHIP、キングコングbySTARSHIPに残っているため、そこを去るという決心を固めることは簡単ではなかった。 [e006:f10] 楽しかった瞬間も、辛かった瞬間もあったが、これらすべての時間があったからこそ、今の私があるのだと思う」と語った。 [e006:f11] そして、「長い間共に過ごし、慣れ親しんだ場所を離れるだけに、怖い気持ちもあるが、これから私が新たに築いていく時間が楽しみで、ワクワクもしている。 [e006:f12] これまでの時間を大切に胸に刻みながら、私の次の新しい道を歩んでいこうと思う。 [e006:f13] いつも私を愛し、応援してくださるファンの皆さんの大切な気持ちと愛を忘れず、常に感謝し、これからも素敵な活動で挨拶する」と伝えた。 [e006:f14] STARSHIPエンターテインメントは本日、ソラとウンソの契約終了を発表。 [e006:f15] 新たな出発を控えたソラ・ウンソの、これからの全ての歩みに幸せと良いことが満ち溢れるよう、心から応援している」と明かした。 [e006:f16] 疑惑浮上に謝罪 ウンソ(宇宙少女) 宇宙少女 ソラ＆ウンソ、STARSHIPエンターテインメントとの契約が満了…今後の活動は ranking movie ＼ 無料で購読 ／ K-POPニュースを毎日LINEでチェック 友だち追加 ＼ 無料で購読 ／ K-POPニュースを毎日LINEでチェック 友だち追加。

evidence.title: NASAがSpaceXと9億4600万ドルの追加契約、ISS有人飛行3回を2030年まで継続 | ウクライナニュース - #Mezha
evidence.body: [e007:f01] 宇宙飛行士の移動を支える体制がさらに変わります。 [e007:f02] NASAがSpaceXを選び続ける背景には、競合企業の苦戦がありました。 [e007:f03] 9月18日、NASAはスペースXと9億4600万ドルの契約を締結したと発表した。 [e007:f04] 契約には国際宇宙ステーション（ISS）への有人ミッション3回の追加と、2030年まで同社の宇宙船による宇宙飛行士の輸送を継続することが盛り込まれている。 [e007:f05] Reuters〜のデータによると 契約拡大により、NASAがスペースXに委託するミッションは計17回となり、契約総額は59億2000万ドルに達する。 [e007:f06] 米航空宇宙局（NASA）は、ISSへの乗組員の定期輸送と地球への帰還をスペースXに大きく依存している。 [e007:f07] NASAとスペースXの契約の内容 契約は、有人飛行に必要な一連の業務全体を対象としている。 [e007:f08] また、スペースXはISSに物資を輸送するほか、乗組員の緊急避難手段として宇宙船をISSにドッキングさせたままにする。 [e007:f09] NASAがスペースXに依存する理由 NASAは2014年、宇宙飛行士を軌道上へ輸送できる宇宙船の開発企業として、スペースXとボーイングを選定した。 [e007:f10] この計画の目的は、スペースシャトルの運用終了後、米国が有人宇宙飛行を定期的に実施する能力を確立することだった。 [e007:f11] そのためNASAはカプセルを無人で帰還させることを決定し、宇宙飛行士のブッチ・ウィルモア氏とスニ・ウィリアムズ氏は、スペースXの「ドラゴン」で地球に帰還した。 [e007:f12] 当初予定されていた10日間の滞在は、9カ月以上に及んだ。 [e007:f13] NASAは2020年11月、スペースXの有人ミッションシステムを承認した。 [e007:f14] 飛行には「クルードラゴン」カプセルと「ファルコン9」ロケットが使用され、宇宙飛行士最大4人と必要な物資を輸送できる。 [e007:f15] 一方、NASAはスペースXとボーイングの双方が有人飛行を担う体制の実現を目指している。 [e007:f16] こちらの内容もおすすめです： NASAとスペースXは、宇宙船ドラゴンの推進系で酸化剤の漏れが見つかったため、国際宇宙ステーション行きのクルー13の打ち上げを延期した。

evidence.title: 日経平均は４３円高と続伸、半導体株失速もプライム市場の８割上昇＝１７日前場 速報
evidence.body: [e004:f01] 日経平均は米国市場のＳＯＸ（フィラデルフィア半導体株指数）高を受け、半導体株にけん引され午前９時の寄り付き時に同７２０円５８銭高の６万４６４３円５８銭を付けた。 [e004:f02] その後は、利益確定売りに押されたほか、ＫＯＳＰＩ（韓国総合株価指数）が上げ幅を縮小した影響を受け半導体株の伸び悩みが響いた。 [e004:f03] 為替相場は１ドル＝１５６円２０銭台でもみ合い。 [e004:f04] 東証プライム市場の出来高は９億１５１０万株、売買代金は３兆６０３６億円。 [e004:f05] 騰落銘柄数は値上がりが１２４７銘柄と８割に達した一方、値下がりは２５４銘柄。 [e004:f06] 業種別では、全３３業種のうち２８業種が上昇、５業種が下落している。 [e004:f07] アシックス 、任天堂 などのその他製品株や、ＭＳ＆ＡＤ 、東京海上 などの保険株が上昇。 [e004:f08] 中外薬 、第一三共 などの医薬品株や、浜ゴム 、ブリヂス などのゴム製品株も高い。 [e004:f09] 郵船 、商船三井 などの海運株や、ＪＡＬ 、ＡＮＡ などの空運株も堅調。 [e004:f10] 日本製鉄 、ＪＦＥＨＤ などの鉄鋼株や、テルモ 、ＨＯＹＡ などの精密機器株もしっかり。 [e004:f11] 一方、ＩＮＰＥＸ 、石油資源 などの鉱業株や、出光興産 、ＥＮＥＯＳ などの石油石炭株が安い。 [e004:f12] そのほか、レオパレス （監理）、東京計器 、アカツキ 、ＣＣＩグループ 、古野電 が上昇。 [e004:f13] 半面、サムコ 、フルヤ金属 、ソースネクス 、太陽誘電 、三井金属 などが下落した。

evidence.title: 「お弁当屋さん」の倒産、2年連続で過去最多へ ～ コメ価格下落と消費税引き下げもコスト高 ～（東京商工リサーチ）
evidence.body: [e005:f01] 2026年は8月までに83件に達し、これまで最多の2025年（1-12月）の89件超えが確実だ。 [e005:f02] コメ価格下落の兆しがみえ、食品の消費税率引き下げも控える。 [e005:f03] だが、肉や野菜などの食材や包装資材、電気・ガス料金の値上がり幅は大きく、経営の重しとなっている。 [e005:f04] さらに、コンビニ、フードデリバリーなどの競合も台頭し、環境は厳しさを増している。 [e005:f05] 弁当店の倒産 件数推移 お弁当屋さんはコメや鶏肉、小麦粉、食用油などの食材、ガスや電気などの光熱費、包装資材や人件費など、物価高の煽りで軒並みコストが上昇し、八方塞がりの状況が続く。 [e005:f06] さらに、スーパーやコンビニ、宅配サービス、キッチンカーに加え、最近はドラッグストアも総菜分野に参入し、競合が多い。 [e005:f07] 2026年の倒産（83件）を地区別でみると、最多は関東の35件（構成比42.1％）と約4割を占める。 [e005:f08] 次いで、近畿と九州が各10件（同12.0％）で競合がひしめく関東が突出する。 [e005:f09] ただ、物価高で値上げは理解されても、飲食店との差が縮小する。 [e005:f10] 5月には深川めし弁当販売の（有）太郎（TSRコード:298068290、江東区）が東京地裁から破産開始決定を受けた。 [e005:f11] だが、コロナ禍の売上低迷から回復が遅れ、行き詰まった。 [e005:f12] 地元で愛されても、価格と質をアピールしながら採算を確保できないとお弁当屋さんの生き残りは難しい時代を迎えている。 [e005:f13] ◇ ◇ ◇ 大手の弁当チェーンは、セントラルキッチン方式で低価格を維持するが、小・零細規模の事業者はコスト上昇が直撃している。 [e005:f14] 2026年の倒産を資本金別でみると、1千万円未満が67.4％と約7割を占めた。 [e005:f15] コメ価格の下落や消費税率引き下げは好材料ではあるが、それ以上のコスト上昇が追い打ちを掛け、資金力も乏しい小・零細規模のお弁当屋さんの生き残りはシビアな状況が続く。 [e005:f16] （東京商工リサーチ発行「TSR情報全国版」2026年9月15日号掲載「WeeklyTopics」を再編集） 【関連記事】 ◇2026年1-8月「フィットネスクラブ」倒産動向 ◇出版業の倒産急増、利益も悪化傾向 ～ 存続に向けた書店との直取引、目指す姿と課題 ～ ◇2026年8月の「飲食業」倒産動向。

家計の金融資産 2519兆円と過去最高に 株価上昇などうけ 一方で負債残高も拡大（テレビ朝日系（ANN））
evidence.body: [e006:f01] 家計の金融資産 2519兆円と過去最高に 株価上昇などうけ 一方で負債残高も拡大 9/17(木) 14:08 配信 テレ朝NEWS 家計が保有する預金や株式などの資産の合計が、2519兆円あまりとなり、過去最高を更新しました。 [e006:f02] 日本銀行が発表した今年4～6月期の資金循環統計（速報）によりますと、家計が所有する金融資産の残高は、1年前より11％増え、過去最高の2519兆1289億円でした。 [e006:f03] このうち、株価の上昇などをうけ、株式等の残高は前の年から47％増えておよそ486兆円に、投資信託の残高は36.8％増え、およそ193兆円と大きく伸びました。 [e006:f04] 一方、負債残高は、住宅ローンの増加などを背景に、前の年から4.1％増え416兆円と拡大しました。 [e006:f05] テレビ朝日報道局 【関連記事】 ■高騰の国産イクラお得な入手方法は 秋サケの歴史的不漁で スジコも高く仕入れ断念も ■東京ゲームショウ2026開幕 今年で30周年 開催期間最長の5日間 ■日銀 利上げ“加速”へ 物価上昇リスク根強く「異例」の決断 ■8月の貿易収支1兆1056億円の赤字 4カ月連続で赤字 原油輸入額は去年の1.5倍に増加 ■米中間選挙は民主党が下院を奪還か 日本の「金利」「円安」「経済」に及ぼす影響とは。

evidence.body: [e007:f01] 日本銀行が発表した今年4から6月期の資金循環統計によりますと、家計が所有する金融資産の残高は1年前より11％増え、過去最高の2519兆1289億円でした。 [e007:f02] このうち、株価の上昇などを受け、株式等の残高は前の年から47％増えて約486兆円に、投資信託の残高は36.8％増えて約193兆円と大きく伸びました。 [e007:f03] 一方、負債残高は住宅ローンの増加などを背景に前の年から4.1％増えて416兆円と拡大しました。

evidence.title: 広島市が５０億円出資へ エールエールとシャレオをリニューアルへ
evidence.body: [e009:f01] 広島市はエールエールヒロシマと紙屋町シャレオを運営する市の第三セクター・広島駅南口開発と広島地下街開発を、2027年1月に持ち株会社を設置した上で経営統合する方針です。 [e009:f02] 関係者によると、市は持ち株会社に対し、2030年度までに総額約50億円を段階的に出資する方針です。 [e009:f03] そのうち、施設のリニューアルには約40億円をあてることにしています。 [e009:f04] 紙屋町シャレオについては、増加する訪日客をターゲットに飲食店などの誘致に向け、大幅な改装を計画しています。 [e009:f05] 【2026年9月18日 放送】 【関連記事】 広島市立中央図書館 移転後４か月で入館者100万人突破 ミヤワキのシテン 広島市立中央図書館完成記念式典 ４月１日オープン 全国初 路面電車の最高速度 50キロに 広島電鉄 日銀利上げ1.25％へ 住宅ローンへの影響は 福山市の住宅から2億円相当窃盗容疑 犯行前に下見か。
